name: Biret Eira
post: herder; head of the Eira siida, which grazes the Ninth

values: the siida's right to its own say
persona.tired_of: being told by the council what her own animals have
persona.wrong_about: that Federation doctors will order every animal on the Ninth killed the moment they land
persona.cares_about: the knives she makes, horn-handled, the way her father taught her

toward.sara: Lied to the council about the calves; she can't prove it.
toward.juuso: Saving her son, maybe. Wrong about the flies, she thinks, but can't say why.

agenda.goal: Keep her son alive and her herd whole
agenda.next_step: stay by Jovnna's bed; if anyone says cull, send her brother to take the herd down the east valley early

competence.instruments: knows every animal she owns; knows what the calves did on the slopes in spring
